airtable.note: API key stored in .env as AIRTABLE_API_KEY

telnyx.note: API key stored in .env as TELNYX_API_KEY

google.note: Google OAuth credentials stored in n8n credential store (Google Drive + Google Docs)

n8n.note: API key stored in .env as N8N_API_KEY

daily_order_upload.name: DabbahWala — Daily Order Upload
daily_order_upload.note: Calls POST /api/daily-orders/process per order, then POST /api/agents/cycle/run-all

marketing_query_form.name: DabbahWala — Marketing Query Form
marketing_query_form.note: Routes query to POST /api/agents/cycle/run-for-contact, stores in Airtable Team Inputs

google_docs_sync.name: DabbahWala — Google Docs Sync
google_docs_sync.note: Inactive until Google Drive + Google Docs OAuth2 credentials are configured in n8n. Folder ID is hardcoded in workflow.

campaign_performance_tracker.name: DabbahWala — Campaign Performance Tracker
campaign_performance_tracker.note: Every hour: GET campaign IDs from Render, fetch analytics per campaign from Instantly, POST stats back to Render DB

instantly_campaign_sync.name: DabbahWala — Instantly Campaign Sync
instantly_campaign_sync.note: Calls POST /api/webhooks/sync-campaigns to fetch Instantly campaigns tagged 'dabbahwala' and upsert into instantly_campaigns DB table.

shipday_feedback_sync.name: DabbahWala — Shipday Feedback Sync
shipday_feedback_sync.note: Calls POST /api/shipday/sync-feedback (days_back=3, synchronous). Polls Shipday API for customer feedback, delivery instructions, and proof-of-delivery on all delivered orders not yet synced. Stores in shipday_communications, fires delivery_update events, creates Opportunities for actionable sentiment. If new comms found, triggers POST /api/lifecycle/run.

google_docs.note: Set up Google Drive + Google Docs OAuth2 credentials in n8n. Folder ID is hardcoded in workflow.

classification.ad_copy: Title contains: ad copy, social media, facebook, instagram, social post
classification.ground_note: Title contains: field note, ground, delivery note, driver (or default)
